_note: Verify each 'model' string against the provider's current model list before running -- these are placeholders and model IDs change independently of this config. Never put an API key value in this file; apiKeyEnvVar names the environment variable to read it from.
_note_maxTokens: 8192 was empirically confirmed too small 2026-08-01: every capability-synthesis and reduce call in the first building test run hit it and was silently truncated (fixed now to fail closed instead -- see llm-adapter.ts's stop_reason/finishReason checks and synthesis-orchestrator.ts's splitMarkedFiles). Raised to 16384 as a first re-tested guess, not a verified ceiling -- if a future call still throws LLM_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED, raise further and re-test rather than assuming this value is enough for every call shape.
_note_gemini: Gemini runs via Vertex AI (not the consumer Generative Language API), authenticated with ADC ('gcloud auth application-default login') rather than an API key -- reflects SSO/enterprise access, no apiKeyEnvVar needed or used for this provider. projectId/location verified working 2026-08-01 against dev-oskey-io under identity david.openshaw@oskey.io. Region matters for MODEL AVAILABILITY, not just uptime -- confirmed 2026-08-11 that europe-west1 only serves the 2.5 generation while us-central1 (and the 'global' endpoint) already serve 3.x models on this same project/identity. Check with a free ai.models.list() call before assuming a model doesn't exist just because one region 404s it.

gemini-default._note: 2026-08-11: CONFIRMED WORKING via a real generateContent call (module 'tasks', both capability-synthesis and connective-tissue calls succeeded end to end). us-central1 showed gemini-3.5-flash as catalog-visible (ai.models.list()/.get()) but generateContent 404'd there -- catalog visibility is NOT the same as generation entitlement per-region. 'global' has both catalog visibility AND real generation access for this model on this project/identity. If adding another 3.x model, verify generateContent specifically (not just .get()/.list()) before trusting it, and prefer 'global' over a specific region for the newer generation until region-by-region entitlement is otherwise confirmed.

claude-default._note: No 'temperature' here deliberately -- claude-sonnet-5 rejects the request outright if it's present at all (HTTP 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model'), confirmed 2026-08-01. The adapter omits it entirely for Anthropic; leaving a value here would misleadingly imply it's respected.
